name: Shopify
commission: Up to $150 per qualified referral; the amount varies by referral location
payoutMethod: Direct deposit or PayPal, in 80+ currencies
notes: Clicks tracked for 30 days; a free trial is then tracked for up to 400 days until the store becomes paid. No commission caps.

name: Semrush
commission: $100–$300 per sale, rising to $450 at Platinum, plus $10 per free trial
notes: Last-click attribution. Transactions lock 27 days after month end and pay 21 days after that.

name: HubSpot
commission: 30% recurring for up to one year, up to $1,000+ per sale

name: Notion
commission: Up to $50 per activated sign-up, plus 20% of year-one revenue
notes: Last-click attribution. Commission is clawed back if the workspace downgrades within two months or is refunded. Not accepting new affiliates at the time of checking.

name: Grammarly
commission: $0.20 per free account sign-up and $20 per upgrade
payoutMethod: Check (US residents only), bank wire, direct deposit
notes: The public page shows commission details as an image without stating the rates in text, and points affiliates to its FAQ. An activation bonus and increased payouts for top performers are mentioned without amounts. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://support.grammarly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037054452-Commissions-and-remittance-options on 2026-09-29.

name: Squarespace
notes: The public page advertises a per-conversion commission without stating the amount. Unlimited referrals, no annual cap.

name: Wix
notes: The public page states no commission, window, threshold or payout method — it describes the program and sends applicants to Impact.

name: monday.com
commission: Up to 100% of a customer's first-year sales, by tier

name: Zendesk
commission: 15% for the first year of sales
notes: No floor or ceiling on referrals or earnings. Top affiliates are said to earn more, without the page saying how much.

name: DigitalOcean
commission: $25 after the referral spends their first $25
notes: A referral-credit program rather than a commission program; the public page states the credit and nothing else.

name: Elementor
commission: 45–55% on first purchases (55% on Elementor One during launch, 45% on Editor Pro and Host)
payoutMethod: PayPal, or another method agreed with Elementor
notes: The page says commissions are for the first purchase only, but also that monthly Elementor One plans earn 55% of the subscriber's first three months of payments, recorded from the fourth month.

name: Printful
commission: 10% of order value, plus $25 for each first-time Growth plan subscription
payoutMethod: PayPal or wire transfer, monthly or on demand
notes: 10% runs for 12 months on B2B store referrals; one-time and guest orders pay 10% once. Calculated on fulfilment price after discounts, excluding tax.

name: Envato
commission: Monthly plans $20, $40 or $80 a month for a maximum of three months by tier; annual plans a single payment of $120, $250 or $500
notes: First-click attribution rather than last. The tiers are Core, Plus and Ultimate.

name: beehiiv
commission: 50–60%, tiered: 50% Bronze, 55% Silver, 60% Gold
notes: Paid on the 15th of each month.

name: Hostinger
commission: Starts at 40% and grows with sales volume
notes: The public page states the headline rate only — the affiliate FAQ states a 30-day cookie and that renewals and upgrades earn no commission. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://www.hostinger.com/affiliates/faqs on 2026-09-29.

name: Teachable
commission: 30% recurring
notes: Runs for the referred creator's entire first year. Tracking covers the whole of teachable.com, not just a landing page.

name: ActiveCampaign
commission: 20–30% of subscription value, rising with new business and retention

name: Deel
commission: $500 per sales-qualified referral plus $1,000 when they become a paying customer, so up to $1,500
notes: The first $500 comes when a referral books a demo and is sales-qualified. The 90-day window runs from the click until the referral qualifies; a qualified referral that takes longer to close still counts.

name: Xero
notes: States that the rate depends on your audience and geography and is discussed only after you apply — the rate is negotiated, not published.

name: n8n
commission: 30% of net revenue on n8n Cloud referrals
notes: Paid on net earnings, so the amount varies by the referral's region and tax treatment.

name: Kinsta
commission: 10% monthly, plus a one-time bonus of up to $500
notes: Last-touch attribution. Runs on Kinsta's own dashboard rather than a third-party network. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://kinsta.com/affiliates/faq/ on 2026-09-29.

name: ElevenLabs
commission: Up to 22%

name: Jasper
commission: 25%, rising to 30% after 100 generated and 100 converted leads
notes: The agreement declines to state the cookie duration — it says only that cookies 'have a set duration' — but sets a hard 14-day deadline from first click for the purchase to count, which is the attribution window in practice. Business plans are excluded. Most-recent-cookie attribution.

name: Descript
commission: $25 per new subscriber referred
notes: Descript is migrating its affiliate program to PartnerStack and existing affiliates must reapply; it isn't stated whether the $25/PayPal terms described elsewhere on the page still apply once that migration completes. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://descript.com/affiliate-terms on 2026-09-29. The terms page says commissions are one-time on the initial subscription term, with none for renewals; affiliates on the earlier recurring structure keep it for existing referrals.

name: VEED
commission: 20% on the initial sale plus 20% recurring, with bonuses up to 50%
notes: Commission sits as pending through a validation period before it clears. Duration of the recurring share is not stated.

name: Apollo.io
commission: 15% on monthly plans, 20% on annual
payoutMethod: Stripe, PayPal or direct deposit, monthly via PartnerStack
notes: Held 30 days against the cancellation policy. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://www.apollo.io/terms/affiliate-partner-program on 2026-09-29.

name: Hunter
commission: 30% recurring
payoutMethod: PayPal, in the first week of each month
notes: Payable 45 days after the customer pays, to cover refunds.

name: Surfer
commission: 75–125% of a monthly subscriber's first payment, or 15–25% of an annual subscription, by tier
notes: Paid on the first payment only. Tiers move at 11 and 51 referrals. Commissions approve 45 days after the referral pays.

name: Mangools
commission: 25%, 30% or 35% by tier
notes: Pays again on every auto-renewal, for as long as the referral keeps subscribing. Commission is on full-price payments only, and payout may be held until at least two different users are referred.

name: Thinkific
commission: 30% lifetime recurring on monthly and annual plans; Plus plans pay $150 per month instead
notes: Paid on the 13th of each month after a 30-day reconciliation hold.

name: Circle
commission: $100 one-time plus 10–20% recurring on Standard plans, by tier
payoutMethod: PayPal, Stripe or direct deposit, via PartnerStack
notes: Tier is set by paying customers referred in the last 12 months: 0–9, 10–49, 50+. Circle Plus plans pay half the Standard rate.

name: Tidio
commission: Up to 30% per sale
notes: The page gives a ceiling rate and a monthly payment cycle and nothing else — no cookie window, threshold or method.

name: Printify
commission: 5% of every sale a referral makes
notes: Runs for 12 consecutive months.

name: Rank Math
commission: 30% per sale
payoutMethod: Paid within 30 days of the refund grace period ending
notes: You may refer clients you manage yourself, but not buy through your own link. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://rankmath.com/affiliate-terms-and-conditions/ on 2026-09-29.

name: zcal
notes: Paid in USD at the end of every month, for as long as the referral stays a customer.

name: SEOWILL
notes: Formerly SEOAnt, and seoant.com redirects here.

name: Chaport
commission: 35% of all payments from referred customers
payoutMethod: Monthly, 30 days after the customer's payment

name: Servebolt
commission: $50 to $699 per signup depending on the plan referred
notes: A separate tiered plan pays 10–25% per sale by monthly referred revenue. Commissions are held 90 days before payout. The page says there is no minimum payout in one place and a $100 minimum in another.

name: DashThis
commission: 20% of subscriptions and add-ons
notes: Payout requires sending an invoice; paid on the 15th monthly. Affiliate links may not be used in paid media.

name: Usermaven
commission: 30% recurring
notes: Commissions release 45 days after the month of the sale. The 14-day cookie is among the shortest here.

name: Anymail Finder
notes: Commissions are payable 45 days after the customer's payment. Paid advertising on any ad network is prohibited.

name: Zyte
notes: Capped at $2,000 per client. Paid monthly on the 15th.

name: Manatal
commission: 20% recurring, uncapped
notes: No annual cap and no minimum sales requirement — the page states both explicitly, which most do not.

name: WP Simple Pay
commission: 20% of the license price
notes: States outright that it does not offer recurring referrals. Paid in USD in the first week of each month, for referrals older than 14 days.

name: VWO
notes: The page states the rate two ways: '10% commission' in three places, and 'Earn 15% (or more) in affiliate fee' in a fourth.

name: Backendless
notes: The page states the rate two ways: '25% of all purchases by referred users within Backendless Cloud for 12 months' at the top, and '50% commission on all payments for 12 months' further down. Further terms read from the vendor's linked page https://backendless.com/joining-the-backendless-affiliate-program/ on 2026-09-29.

name: JustCall
notes: Recurring for two years at a rate the page ties to the referral's plan but never states.

name: Kamatera
notes: The terms page sets out payment rules and refers to a 'base rate' it never states.

name: Trackdesk
notes: Promises a 'transparent commission structure' and recurring commissions without publishing a rate.
